details.description:

Originating from Bikaner, Rajasthan, this crunchy delicacy is made from gram flour (besan) and a blend of aromatic spices, formed into fine, crispy strands and then deep-fried to perfection. Indulge in the authentic taste and crunchy texture of this traditional Indian snack, made with quality ingredients for a truly satisfying experience.

details.description: Indulge in the sweet elegance of Bikano Royal Rasgulla, a delectable Indian dessert that captures the essence of authentic sweetness. Crafted with premium cottage cheese (chenna) and infused with the aromatic essence of rose water, these spongy, soft and juicy balls are immersed in a sumptuous sugar syrup, creating a symphony of flavours that delight the senses. Each bite offers a burst of sweetness and a melt-in-your-mouth texture, making it a true connoisseur's delight. Perfect for festive celebrations and gatherings, Bikano Royal Rasgulla is a classic Indian sweet that adds a touch of cultural richness to any occasion.
details.ingredients: Sugar Syrup (95.2%), Chhana (4.3%), Rose Water
details.storageInstructions:
*Store the content in cool, dry and hygienic condition
*Protect the contents from air and direct sunlight

details.description: Indulge in the Sweet Extravaganza of Bikano Royal Gulab Jamun! Bikano Royal Gulab Jamun presents an exquisite blend of tradition and taste. These velvety, golden-brown delights are meticulously crafted from Milk Solids and wheat flour, forming soft, heavenly balls that melt in your mouth. Each piece is immersed in a luscious Sugar Syrup, enhancing the sweetness and creating an irresistible treat. It's a symphony of textures and tastes, perfect for joyous occasions. Beware, it's a temptation for wheat and milk enthusiasts! Dive into the blissful world of indulgence with Bikano Royal Gulab Jamun.

Cham Cham is a popular traditional Bengali sweet made from chhena (a type of fresh curd cheese), similar to rasgulla. It is typically oval-shaped and soaked in sugar syrup, often flavoured with cardamom. This delicacy is enjoyed during festivals and celebrations, making it a beloved treat in Indian cuisine.
This is a small round shaped sweet ball filled with the flavour of saffron. The traditional Indian sweet is famous for its sweet name. Tame your sweet cravings with these amazing sweet delight.
Rajbhog is prepared with chenna, stuffed with a mixture of khoya, pista, and almonds. Tame your sweet cravings with these amazing sweet delight. Perfect to serve the guests.
details.ingredients: Sugar Syrup, Water, Sugar, Sodium Bisulphite (E222), Cottage Cheese (Chenna), Rose Water, Saffron
details.storageInstructions: Store in a cool, dry and hygienic place.

details.description: Indulge in the refreshing and earthy delight of Khus syrup, a dark green elixir crafted from the roots of vetiver grass. This versatile syrup boasts a sweet, woody flavour and scent that can elevate a variety of summer coolers and desserts. Lightweight and easy to mix, it adds a natural twist to your recipes, delivering a soothing and delightful experience. Perfect for quenching thirst or adding a unique touch to your culinary creations, Khus syrup is a must-have addition to your pantry, promising a taste of nature's finest.
details.ingredients: Sugar, Colour, Khus
details.storageInstructions:
*Store in cool, dry and hygienic place
*Protect from heat, direct sunlight and water
*Do not refrigerate

details.description: The dark pink, floral fragrance of rose is replicated in flavour and taste when blended with large amounts of sugar to create rose syrup.
details.ingredients: Sugar, Colour, Rose Flavour
details.storageInstructions: Store beverages in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight and strong odours. Keep containers tightly sealed to maintain freshness and always check the expiry date before use.
details.usageInstructions: One can use as a cool drink with water or milk and even used to garnish and give flavour to a variety of desserts and sundaes.

details.description: Indulge in the rich, aromatic flavours of Bikano's Thandai Kesaria syrup, a delightful blend of saffron, spices, and traditional Indian herbs. This non-carbonated beverage is a true celebration of festive indulgence, perfect for creating refreshing drinks during the summer or for special occasions. Infused with the goodness of melon seeds, cucumber seeds, rose water, white pepper, aniseed, poppy seeds, black pepper, cardamom and more, this syrup brings the authentic taste of thandai to life in every sip. Enjoy the perfect balance of sweetness and spice, and treat your taste buds to a truly delightful experience. Whether you're looking to cool down on a hot day or add a touch of tradition to your celebrations, Bikano's Thandai Kesaria syrup is the perfect choice.
details.ingredients: Saffron (Kesar), Almonds, Fennel Seeds, Magaztari Seeds, Rose Petals, Pepper, Khus Khus Seeds
details.storageInstructions: *Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight
